夜が明けようとしていた。
森を進むごとに口数は減り、沈黙は重くなっていく。
この森を抜けた時、衛宮士郎はその男と対決しなくてはならない。
勝算はなく、戦えば敗北するのは必定だ。
ひとたび剣を合わせれば、無惨に殺されるだけだという事も判っている。

pages.en:
Dawn is near.

The farther we advance through the forest, the less we speak, and the heavier our silence becomes.

When he emerges from these woods, Shirou Emiya will have to confront that man.

He has no prospect of victory. If they fight, his defeat is certain.

He knows that the moment their swords cross, he will merely be butchered.

」
恐れがないのは、開き直ったからでも覚悟したからでもない。
死ぬというのなら、あの男はとうに死んでいる。
それに気が付いてしまった時点で、衛宮士郎も死んだに等しい。
そんな身分で、自身の死をどうだのと憂いる余裕などないだけだ。

I am not unafraid because I have resigned myself to it, nor because I have summoned some final resolve.

If this is about dying, that man is already dead.

From the moment I realized that, Shirou Emiya was as good as dead himself.

Someone in my position has no leisure left to worry over his own death.

城門を抜ける。
この先にある戦いがどんなモノか理解しているのか、セイバーの貌は暗かった。

We pass through the castle gates.

Perhaps she understands the nature of the battle waiting beyond them, for Saber's face is dark.

彼女を悩ませているモノは、オレでありヤツだった。
どちらが生きどちらが敗れようと、消える者は同じだ。
そんな馬鹿げた戦いを、彼女は今でも止めるべきだと苦悩している。
中空を見据える目は厳しく、或いは、不毛な戦いに怒っているのかもしれない。

The cause of her anguish is both him and me.

Whichever survives and whichever is defeated, the one who disappears will be the same.

Even now, she struggles with the belief that she ought to prevent so senseless a battle.

Her eyes are stern as they stare into empty space. Perhaps she is angry at its futility.

朝靄にけぶるこの場所が、お互いの死地となる。
「来たか。随分と遅い到着だな、衛宮士郎」

聞き慣れた声は二階から。
崩れた階段の上、朝日差す踊り場に、その男の姿があった。

The great hall lies in ruins.

This place, veiled in morning mist, will become our shared ground of death.

“So you have come. You took your time, Shirou Emiya.”

A voice stripped of warmth echoes through the hall.

That familiar voice comes from the second floor.

Above the broken stairs, upon a landing washed in morning light, stands the man.

だが見える。
その細部にいたるまで敵の姿を確認できる。
それは、鷹の目を持つというヤツとて同じだろう。

The red mantle is distant, its wearer blurred within the white landscape.

But I can see him.

I can discern every detail of my enemy.

The same must be true for the man said to possess the eyes of a hawk.

弓兵でありながら弓兵でなく、多くの宝具を持ち、惜しげもなくそれらを散らしていった矛盾した存在。
手にする宝具は全て複製であり、無限に剣を製造する事があの男の宝具だった。

pages.en:
A Servant assigned the role of Archer.

A contradictory existence: an archer who was no archer, who possessed a multitude of Noble Phantasms and scattered them without regret.

Every Noble Phantasm he wielded was a reproduction. His true Noble Phantasm was the power to manufacture swords without end.

……その真名に、自分だけが気づかなかった。
英霊はあらゆる時代から召喚される。
過去に該当する者がいないのなら、その英霊は未だ誕生していない未来のモノだ。

…I alone failed to recognize his identity—to see his True Name.

Heroic Spirits are summoned from every age.

If no one in the past corresponds to a given spirit, then that Heroic Spirit belongs to a future in which he has yet to be born.

pages.ja:

ヤツの言う通り、衛宮士郎があのペンダントを生涯持ち続けたというのなら、それは。

If he speaks the truth—if Shirou Emiya carried that pendant all his life—then the answer is——

One small jewel, the only one of its kind.

His life was saved, and though he never learned the identity of his savior, he carried the pendant that must have belonged to her for the rest of his days.

…That is the answer.

If he carried Tohsaka's pendant, then his identity can only be——

英霊エミヤ。
未来の自分。
未熟な衛宮士郎の能力を完成させ、その理想を叶えた男が、目の前にいる英霊の真名だった。

pages.en:
——The Heroic Spirit Emiya.

My future self.

The man who completed Shirou Emiya's immature abilities and realized his ideal—that is the True Name of the Heroic Spirit before me.

No one else is in sight.

He stands alone in the ruined hall.

“And so I killed.

“To save one person, I trampled the wishes of dozens. Then, to save those I had trampled, I cast aside the wishes of even more.

“I murdered salvation for dozens, preserved only what I could see before me, and killed still more hopes.

“Each time I told myself this would be the end. This time, no one would have to grieve. I persisted in that paltry stubbornness.”

“Because everyone present cannot be saved, someone must inevitably be sacrificed.

“——And so——

“To minimize the harm, I cut away those destined to be left out with my own hands—swiftly, even one second sooner.

“That is the course proper to a hero, to the Hero of Justice that man believed his ideal.”

The wish that no one should ever grieve.

The ideal of saving as many people as possible.

When the two coexist and contradict each other, there is only one course to take.

「多くの人間を救う、というのが正義の味方だろう？ だから殺した。誰も死なさないようにと願ったまま、大勢の為に一人には死んで貰った。
誰も悲しまないようにと口にして、その陰で何人かの人間には絶望を抱かせた」

pages.en:
“A Hero of Justice is one who saves the greater number, is he not? And so I killed. Still wishing that no one should die, I had one person die for the sake of the many.

“I declared that no one should grieve, while consigning several people beyond my sight to despair.”

pages.ja:
「そのうちそれにも慣れてきてね、理想を守る為に理想に反し続けた。
自分が助けようとした人間しか救わず、敵対した者は速やかに皆殺しにした。犠牲になる“誰か”を容認する事で、かつての理想を守り続けた」

pages.en:
“Eventually I grew accustomed even to that. I violated my ideal again and again in order to preserve it.

“I saved only the people I had chosen to save, and promptly slaughtered everyone who opposed me. By accepting that *someone* must be sacrificed, I continued to protect the ideal I once held.”

pages.ja:
「それがこのオレ、英雄エミヤの正体だ。
そら。
そんな男は、今のうちに死んだ方が世の為と思わないか？」
pages.jaRuby:
「それがこのオレ、英雄エミヤの正体だ。
そら。
そんな男は、今のうちに死んだ方が世の為と思わないか？」
pages.en:
“That is the truth of the man before you—of the hero Emiya.

“——Well?

“Would the world not be better served if such a man died while he was still young?”

pages.ja:

……だが。
その言葉に逆らったのは、果たして誰だったのか。

pages.en:
It is true.

A Hero of Justice can save only those whose side he has chosen.

…But——

Who was it that once rebelled against those very words?

“——————”

The knight's steps cease.

For the briefest instant——only once——his brow clouds with bitterness.

“You did not betray your ideal. The ideal you protected betrayed you, and you merely lost sight of your path.

“If that were not so, you would never seek to atone by doing something like——killing yourself.”

“——————”

The sardonic curve vanishes from his mouth.

The knight stares directly at Saber with a face frozen still——then——

“——Ha. Haha, hahahahahahahaha!”

As though she has said something genuinely hilarious, he bursts into laughter.

オレが自分の罪を償う？ 馬鹿な事を言うなよセイバー。

“Heh——hahahahahahaha! No, this is a masterpiece.

“I would atone for my sins? Do not be absurd, Saber.

“I have no sins for which to atone, nor do I recall ever forcing so irresponsible a burden upon anyone else.”

The knight appears perfectly calm.

His voice is low, and only his muffled laughter echoes through the hall.

「ああ、そうだったよセイバー。確かにオレは何度も裏切られ欺かれた。救った筈の男に罪を被せられた事もある。死ぬ思いで争いを収めてみれば、争いの張本人だと押し付けられて最後には絞首台だ。
そら。オレに罪があるというのなら、その時点で償っているだろう？」

pages.en:
“Yes, Saber. You were right about one thing. I was betrayed and deceived again and again. Once, a man I had saved even laid his crimes upon me. I nearly died to end a conflict, only to be named the instigator——and in the end, sent to the gallows.

“There. If I had any sins, surely I paid for them then?”

pages.ja:

うそだ、アーチャー。貴方の、最期は」

pages.en: “N-no… That's a lie, Archer. Your end was——”

pages.ja:
「……ふん。まあそういう事だ。
だが、そんな事はどうでもよかった。初めから感謝をして欲しかった訳じゃない。英雄などともてはやされる気もなかった。オレはただ、誰もが幸福だという結果だけが欲しかっただけだ。
だが、それが叶えられた事はない。
生前も、その死後も」

pages.en:
“…Hmph. That is more or less what happened.

“But none of it mattered. I never wanted gratitude. I had no desire to be celebrated as a hero. I wanted only the result in which everyone was happy.

“——But not once was that result achieved.

“Not in life, and not after death.”

くぐもった笑いは既にない。
ヤツから漏れる言葉には、もう、憎悪しか含まれていなかった。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
The muffled laughter is gone.

Nothing but hatred remains in the words escaping him.

「守護者とは、“霊長の存命”のみを優先する無色の力だ。
力は高き処にありて、人の世が滅亡する可能性が生じれば世に下る。
……ソレがただの奴隷である事は知っていた。
死後、己が存在を守護者に預けたモノは輪廻の枠から外れ、無と同意になるのだと」

pages.en:
“A Guardian is a colorless force that gives priority to one thing alone: the continued existence of humanity.

“That power abides in a higher plane and descends when the possibility arises that the human world may perish.

“…I knew it was nothing but slavery.

“I knew that one who surrendered his existence after death to the Counter Force would pass beyond the cycle of reincarnation and become equivalent to nothingness.”

pages.ja:
「それでも、誰かを救えるのならそれでいい。
かつてのエミヤシロウは、その誓いを守れなかった。
なら
守護者となって“人間の滅亡”とやらを食い止める一端になるのなら、それでいいと思ったのだ」

pages.en:
“Even so, if I could save someone, that was enough.

“The Shirou Emiya of that time had failed to keep his vow.

“Then——if becoming a Guardian allowed me to play some part in preventing this so-called extinction of humanity, I believed that would be enough.”

pages.ja:
「
だが実際は違う。守護者は人など救わない。
守護者がする事はただの掃除だ。既に起きてしまった事、作られてしまった人間の業を、その力で無にするだけの存在だった」

pages.en:
“——But the truth was different. Guardians save no one.

“All they perform is cleanup. They are beings that use their power merely to erase what has already happened—the sins mankind has already brought into being.”

pages.ja:
「ソレは人を救うのではなく、世界に害を与えるであろう人々を、善悪の区別なく無くすだけ。
絶望に嘆く人々を救うのではなく、絶望と無関係に生を謳歌する部外者を救う為に、絶望する人々を排除するだけの殺戮者。
馬鹿げた話だ。それが、今までの自分と何が違う」

pages.en:
“They do not save people. They simply erase, without distinction between good and evil, those who would bring harm to the world.

“They do not rescue those weeping in despair. They are slaughterers who eliminate the despairing in order to save outsiders living happily beyond the reach of that despair.

“——It is absurd. How is that any different from what *I* had always done?”

pages.ja:

むしろ絶望が増しただけだ。
自分一人の力では叶わないから、より大きな力に身を預けた。
だが、その先も結局は同じだったのだ。
その力ならば叶うと思った事なのに、その力は、ヤツがした事を、更に巨大にしただけのモノだとしたら。

——It is no different at all.

It only deepened his despair.

His own strength had been unequal to the task, so he entrusted himself to a greater power.

But what awaited him was ultimately the same.

He believed that power could realize what he could not——only to discover that it had merely magnified everything he himself had done.

pages.en:
“…Archer. All this time, you have been——”

“I grew accustomed to that as well. Humanity repeats itself. In every age, the strong strip the weak of everything they possess. And I was taught that this was the most efficient form of prosperity.”

「
ああ、何度も見てきた。
意味のない殺戮も、意味のない平等も、意味のない幸福も……！
オレ自身が拒んでも見せられた。守護者となったオレには、もはや自分の意志などない。ただ人間の意思によって呼び出され、人間が作ってしまった罪の後始末をさせられるだけだったからな」

pages.en:
“——Yes. I witnessed it time and again.

“Meaningless slaughter, meaningless equality, meaningless happiness…!

“Even when I refused, I was forced to watch. As a Guardian, I no longer possessed a will of my own. I was merely summoned by the will of humanity and made to clean up the sins humanity had wrought.”

pages.ja:
それが、ヤツが辿り着いた結末だった。
人間が生み出した欲望を消す為だけの存在。
誰かを救うのではなく、救われなかった人々の存在を無かった事にするだけの守護者。

pages.en:
That was the end he reached.

An existence whose only purpose was to erase the desires created by human beings.

A Guardian who saved no one, but merely made it as though the people who could not be saved had never existed.

一人でも多くの人間を救うのだと。
その思いだけで英雄になった男は、結局
ただの一度も、それを叶える事がなかったのか。

pages.en:
Again and again——

he witnessed the sins of human beings bent upon their own destruction, then burned them away like so much refuse.

He became a hero with only one thought: that he would save as many people as possible.

And in the end——did he fail to realize that wish even once?

オレが望んだモノはそんな事ではなかった。
オレはそんなモノの為に、守護者になどなったのではない…………！！！！」

pages.en:
“——Yes. That is wrong.

“That is not what I desired.

“I did not become a Guardian for something like that…………!”

pages.en:
The cry of rage welling from him is probably directed at himself alone.

What stands there is the wreckage of a man worn away long ago.

The hero Emiya was condemned forever to witness the ugliness of the human beings he once meant to save.

pages.ja:
その果てに憎んだ。
奪い合いを繰り返す人間と、それを尊いと思っていた、かつての自分そのものを。

pages.en:
And in the end, he came to hate them.

The people who endlessly robbed one another——and the former self who had once believed those people precious.

pages.en:
“I want no part in cleaning up after humanity. But now that I am a Guardian, there is no escape from this cycle.

“——With one exception.”

ヤツの目にセイバーはいない。
アーチャーの目的はただ一つ、自身の消去だ。

Unwavering bloodlust kindles in his cold eyes.

He no longer sees Saber.

Archer has only one objective: his own erasure.

Yet even if the summoned man dies, the original Emiya upon the Throne beyond the cycle of the world will not disappear.

One who has become a Guardian cannot be annihilated.

It is already “nothing,” a thing outside this world's cycle. Killing it would have no meaning.

…But——

if there is one way for him to vanish, it is this.

Kill the man destined to become the hero before that hero can be born.

Therefore——

pages.jaRuby: 「シロウを、ここで殺すというのですか。他でもない、貴方自身の手によって」
pages.en: “You mean to kill Shirou here. You will do it with your own hands.”

pages.ja:
「そうだ。その機会だけを待ち続けた。果てしなくゼロに近い確率だ。
だがそれに賭けた。そう思わなければ自身を許容できなかった。ただその時だけを希望にして、オレは守護者などというモノを続けてきた」

“Yes. I have waited endlessly for this one opportunity. Its probability is as near to zero as makes no difference.

“But I wagered upon it. Without that hope, I could not endure my own existence. Clinging to this moment alone, I continued to serve as the thing called a Guardian.”

Just as he says, it has been one long act of bravado, terribly twisted from beginning to end.

I have lost more than I ever gained.

And that is precisely why——

for the sake of everything I left behind, Shirou Emiya cannot retreat.
